description: An invoice. Base every value on what is printed on the document — never infer a figure it does not state, and never compute one yourself. Use null (or an empty array) wherever the document is silent. Dates as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Money as a plain number, with no symbol or thousands separator.

invoice_number.description: The invoice's own identifier, as printed.

po_number.description: The purchase order tied to the invoice, as printed.

vendor_name.description: Legal name of the party issuing the invoice.

vendor_address.description: The vendor's address on one line.

bill_to_name.description: Name of the party being billed.

ship_to_name.description: Name of the party the goods are shipped to. Null when the invoice does not distinguish it from the billed party.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for every amount on the invoice (USD, CAD). Infer from an unambiguous symbol or the jurisdiction; null if genuinely unclear.

subtotal.description: Total before tax, as stated. Do not add the lines up yourself.

total.description: Amount payable including tax, as stated.

amount_due.description: Balance still owing, when the invoice states one separately from the total — a deposit or credit already applied.

taxes.description: One entry per tax applied. Empty array when none are.

name.description: Label of the tax, as printed.

percentage.description: Rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

additional_charges.description: Charges beyond the line items — shipping, handling, fuel surcharge. Empty array when none.

name.description: Label of the charge, as printed.

line_items.description: One entry per billed line, in document order. Empty array when the invoice has no itemisation. Nested, so these values are not individually cited — the top-level totals are.

notes.description: Remittance instructions, late-payment terms or anything else materially conditioning payment.
